# Reference-video-remix P0 fixtures

This directory contains the reproducible fixture manifest, not media. Source media, model weights, and rendered outputs must stay outside Git.

Obtain each asset listed in `cases.json` from the controlled test-asset store and place it below the `--asset-root` directory with the listed relative path. Before the gate can pass, add per-case `provenance` (`kind: approved-real`, source ID, license, approver, approval time and approval ID) and an `asset_inventory` entry for every required path (SHA-256, source ID, license, approver and retrieval time). The harness re-hashes the supplied bytes. A global command-line label cannot make a fixture eligible. Do not substitute synthetic tone audio for a human Chinese or English narration sample.

For `zh-clear` and `en-clear`, provide `script.txt`, the same approved script as actual `fast` and `slow` narration takes, `fast-annotations.json` and `slow-annotations.json`, plus a background image and B-roll video. Each annotation file is JSON with a `boundaries` array and `provenance` containing `method: manual`, nonempty `annotator_ids`, `reviewed_by`, `annotated_at`, and the exact `source_audio_sha256`. Every boundary identifies an exact Unicode code-point interval with `start_char`, `end_char`, `start_us`, and `end_us`; it is compared with the actual runner output. The harness uses no saved aligner output as a substitute for execution.

The repeated-text case declares the exact repeated token, number and emoji and is aligned like a normal speech case. The no-speech audio must make the runner report no speech. Both omission and insertion audio must make the runner report an ASR/script mismatch. The VFR case must have unequal nominal and average frame rates; the harness performs its declared crop/speed transform and verifies dimensions and duration. The clear-speech entries also declare a required event selection, which avoids ambiguous first-match handling for repeated text.

The checked-in manifest intentionally has no media, annotations, or hashes. It is a declaration of missing evidence, so the P0 command reports `blocked` until controlled assets and annotations are supplied. The command counts annotation records from the supplied JSON files; do not edit the manifest to manufacture a boundary count.
